questions.question_hindi:
संगठनात्मक संप्रेषण में प्रयुक्त जोहारी विंडो मॉडल (Johari Window Model) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. 'मुक्त क्षेत्र' (Open Area) उस जानकारी को दर्शाता है जो स्वयं को ज्ञात है और दूसरों को भी ज्ञात है।
II. 'अंध क्षेत्र' (Blind Area) उस जानकारी को दर्शाता है जो दूसरों को ज्ञात है परंतु स्वयं को अज्ञात है।
III. दूसरों से प्राप्त प्रतिपुष्टि (Feedback) 'अंध क्षेत्र' को कम करने में मदद करती है।
IV. आत्म-प्रकटीकरण (Self-disclosure) 'प्रच्छन्न क्षेत्र' (Hidden Area) को कम करने में मदद करता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
options_hindi: I और II
I, II, और III
II, III, और IV
I, II, III, और IV

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Johari Window model used in organizational communication:
I. The ‘Open Area’ represents information known to self and known to others.
II. The ‘Blind Area’ represents information known to others but unknown to self.
III. Feedback from others helps reduce the ‘Blind Area’.
IV. Self-disclosure helps reduce the ‘Hidden Area’.
Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I and II
I, II, and III
II, III, and IV
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). The Johari Window, devised by Joseph Luft and Harry Ingham, maps interpersonal awareness into four quadrants based on whether information is known/unknown to self and known/unknown to others:
1. Open Area (Arena): Known to self and known to others (Statement I is correct).
2. Blind Area (Blind Spot): Unknown to self, but known to others (Statement II is correct). Constructive feedback from team members reduces this quadrant by making the person aware of blind spots (Statement III is correct).
3. Hidden Area (Façade): Known to self, but unknown to others. Active self-disclosure reduces this quadrant by revealing information, thereby expanding the Open Area (Statement IV is correct).
4. Unknown Area: Unknown to self and unknown to others.
Since statements I, II, III, and IV are all correct, Option (d) is the right answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। जोसेफ लुफ्ट और हैरी इंगम द्वारा प्रतिपादित जोहारी विंडो मॉडल पारस्परिक संप्रेषण और आत्म-जागरूकता को चार चतुर्थांशों में बांटता है:
1. मुक्त क्षेत्र (Open Area): जो स्वयं को और दूसरों दोनों को ज्ञात है (कथन I सही है)।
2. अंध क्षेत्र (Blind Area): जो दूसरों को दिखाई देता है परंतु स्वयं को पता नहीं होता (कथन II सही है)। दूसरों से सकारात्मक फीडबैक लेने से यह अंध क्षेत्र घटता है (कथन III सही है)।
3. प्रच्छन्न क्षेत्र (Hidden Area): जो स्वयं को पता है किंतु दूसरों से छिपाकर रखा गया है। आत्म-प्रकटीकरण (Self-disclosure) से यह क्षेत्र कम होता है और खुला क्षेत्र बढ़ता है (कथन IV सही है)।
4. अज्ञात क्षेत्र (Unknown Area): जो न तो स्वयं को ज्ञात है और न दूसरों को।
अतः चारों कथन सही हैं और विकल्प (d) सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, III, and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Johari Window model categorizes interpersonal awareness across four quadrants based on self and external knowledge. The open area encompasses shared awareness, while the blind area contains traits known to others but unperceived by oneself. Constructive feedback effectively reduces the blind area, whereas active self-disclosure diminishes the hidden area, fostering enhanced communication, transparency, and trust within teams.

questions.question_english: A Principal reviews annual examination results and identifies a consistent pattern of low scores in mathematics across all sections. She institutes a committee of mathematics teachers to analyze root causes, identify pedagogical gaps, and formulate an instructional intervention strategy. This data-driven, problem-solving approach exemplifies:
options_english: Traditional punitive administrative action
Unstructured laissez-faire leadership model
Evidence-based quality assurance decision-making
Rigid centralized autocratic control framework
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Analyzing empirical performance data to diagnose learning deficiencies and collaboratively formulating targeted instructional strategies is a classic example of evidence-based decision-making in educational Total Quality Management (TQM). Rather than resorting to punitive or subjective measures, the principal leverages objective evidence and professional faculty collaboration to drive continuous school improvement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। विद्यार्थियों के प्रदर्शन डेटा का उपयोग करके शैक्षणिक कमियों की पहचान करना तथा शिक्षकों के साथ मिलकर सुधारात्मक शिक्षण रणनीति तैयार करना 'साक्ष्य-आधारित गुणवत्ता आश्वासन' (Evidence-based Quality Assurance) का परिचायक है। यह दृष्टिकोण दंडात्मक उपायों के स्थान पर वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रमाणों और सहयोगात्मक संवाद के माध्यम से निरंतर गुणवत्ता सुधार को बढ़ावा देता है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Evidence-based quality assurance decision-making

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Analyzing student performance data to identify instructional gaps and collaboratively developing targeted pedagogical strategies exemplifies evidence-based quality assurance. Rather than relying on punitive measures or subjective assumptions, leadership utilizes empirical evidence to drive continuous instructional improvement, aligning academic intervention with systematic quality management principles to elevate institutional standards.

questions.question_english: You are tasked with analyzing your school’s institutional plan. You note that the plan includes acquiring smartboards, but there is no corresponding budget or training scheduled for teachers. This plan primarily fails the criteria of being:
options_english: Participatory and Democratic
Realistic and Coordinated
Visionary and Ambitious
Detailed and Lengthy
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). A sound institutional plan must satisfy the criteria of being realistic and coordinated. Planning for significant physical infrastructure upgrades (such as interactive smartboards) without allocating matching financial resources or scheduling capacity-building training for pedagogical staff reflects an uncoordinated and ungrounded plan. Effective educational administration requires synchronizing physical procurement, budgetary outlays, and human competency development.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एक प्रभावी संस्थागत योजना की बुनियादी आवश्यकता यह है कि वह यथार्थवादी (रियलिस्टिक) और समन्वित (कोऑर्डिनेटेड) होनी चाहिए। स्मार्टबोर्ड जैसे आधुनिक तकनीकी उपकरणों को शामिल करना, किंतु उनके लिए वित्तीय बजट न रखना और शिक्षकों के क्षमता संवर्धन हेतु प्रशिक्षण की योजना न बनाना इस बात का प्रमाण है कि योजना व्यावहारिक धरातल से कटी हुई और असंतुलित है। संसाधनों, बजट और मानव संसाधन क्षमता का आपसी समन्वय ही किसी योजना के सफल क्रियान्वयन की पूर्वशर्त है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Realistic and Coordinated

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An effective institutional plan must align ambitious educational goals with realistic resource allocation, budget constraints, and staff training schedules. Proposing major physical infrastructure upgrades without allocating corresponding financial resources or providing necessary professional development neglects practical implementation needs, rendering the plan uncoordinated, unrealistic, and difficult to achieve in practice.

questions.question_english: Which of the following leadership styles is generally considered most detrimental to fostering a positive Human Resource Development (HRD) climate in an educational institution?
options_english: Transformational leadership style
Democratic and participative leadership style
Distributed leadership style
Authoritarian / Autocratic leadership style
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). An authoritarian (or autocratic) leadership style centralizes decision-making, demands strict obedience, and suppresses employee initiative, which severely damages trust, psychological safety, and open communication. Human Resource Development (HRD) thrives on values such as Openness, Collaboration, Trust, Autonomy, Proactivity, Authenticity, and Confrontation (OCTAPAC). Autocratic leadership stifles these elements, demotivating staff and blocking professional growth. In contrast, transformational, democratic, and distributed leadership styles foster empowerment, collaboration, and high morale.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। अधिनायकवादी या निरंकुश (ऑटोक्रैटिक) नेतृत्व शैली निर्णय लेने की शक्ति का पूर्ण केंद्रीकरण करती है, कठोर आज्ञाकारिता की माँग करती है और कर्मचारियों की स्वायत्तता व पहल को दबाती है। मानव संसाधन विकास (HRD) 'OCTAPAC' मूल्यों (खुलापन, सहयोग, विश्वास, स्वायत्तता, अग्रसक्रियता, प्रामाणिकता और सामना करना) पर आधारित होता है। निरंकुश शैली इन मूल्यों को नष्ट कर शिक्षकों के मनोबल और व्यावसायिक विकास को बाधित करती है। इसके विपरीत, रूपांतरणकारी, लोकतांत्रिक और वितरित नेतृत्व शैलियाँ सहभागिता और सशक्तिकरण को बढ़ावा देती हैं।
questions.topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Authoritarian/Autocratic

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An authoritarian or autocratic leadership style significantly hinders the creation of a positive HRD climate. By centralizing decision-making authority, enforcing strict compliance, suppressing initiative, and minimizing open communication, autocratic leaders undermine trust, autonomy, and collaboration. This restrictive approach demotivates staff and discourages the risk-taking and continuous growth essential for HRD success.

questions.question_english: According to statutory provisions under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, what percentage of the members of a School Management Committee (SMC) must be parents or guardians of students studying in the school?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Section 21 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 mandates that at least three-fourths (75%) of the members of a School Management Committee (SMC) must be parents or guardians of children admitted to the school. Furthermore, proportionate representation is given to disadvantaged and weaker sections, and at least 50% of the committee members must be women. The remaining 25% comprises teachers, local authority representatives, and educationists.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 21 के अनुसार, विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) के कम से कम तीन-चौथाई (75%) सदस्य विद्यालय में पढ़ने वाले बच्चों के माता-पिता या अभिभावक होने अनिवार्य हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त समिति के कुल सदस्यों में से 50% महिलाएँ होना आवश्यक है। शेष 25% सदस्य शिक्षक, स्थानीय निकाय के प्रतिनिधि और शिक्षाविद होते हैं।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) 75%

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act of 2009 mandates statutory community representation in school management. Under Section 21, at least seventy-five percent of School Management Committee members must be parents or guardians of enrolled children. This provision ensures democratic community participation, strengthens institutional accountability, and guarantees that local educational planning reflects families’ direct needs.

Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Sensitivity training (T-group) is a common HRD intervention used to increase self-awareness and understanding of group dynamics.
Reason (R): Sensitivity training is highly structured and focuses exclusively on improving a teacher’s subject-matter knowledge.
In the context of the above statements, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Sensitivity training, or T-group training, is an unstructured experiential learning intervention aimed at increasing self-awareness, emotional intelligence, and interpersonal skills within group settings. Because it focuses on emotional dynamics and personal interactions rather than structured academic subject matter, asserting that it strictly targets subject-matter knowledge represents an incorrect characterization of this technique.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। अभिकथन (A) सत्य है क्योंकि कर्ट लेविन द्वारा प्रतिपादित संवेदनशीलता प्रशिक्षण (T-Group) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य प्रतिभागियों में आत्म-बोध, अंतर्वैयक्तिक संवेदनशीलता और समूह प्रक्रियाओं की गहरी समझ विकसित करना है। परंतु कारण (R) असत्य है क्योंकि टी-ग्रुप अत्यधिक संरचित नहीं होता, बल्कि यह एक असंरचित और अनौपचारिक अनुभवजन्य प्रक्रिया है जिसमें कोई पूर्व-निर्धारित पाठ्यक्रम या व्याख्यान नहीं होता और न ही इसका उद्देश्य विषय-वस्तु (सब्जेक्ट मैटर) का ज्ञान बढ़ाना होता है; यह केवल तात्कालिक मानवीय व्यवहार और संबंधों पर केंद्रित होता है।

questions.question_english: Which institutional record serves as the most critical permanent legal document detailing a student's initial enrollment, personal demographics, academic progression, and formal departure from the school?
options_english: The Daily Student Attendance Register
The Official Institutional Log Book
The Admission and Withdrawal Register
The Student Cumulative Anecdotal Record
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). The Admission and Withdrawal Register (often termed the Scholar's Register or General Register) is the primary permanent statutory document maintained by an educational institution. It documents an unbroken legal record of every pupil admitted, including full name, parentage, date of birth, caste/category, date of admission, enrollment number, academic progress/class progression, and date and cause of withdrawal/issuance of school leaving certificate. By statutory education department rules, this register must be preserved permanently. Option (a) is typically retained for a limited duration (e.g., 3-5 years). Option (b), the Log Book, records special events, official visits, and inspections. Option (d) tracks qualitative behavioral anecdotes and is maintained during the pupil's tenure.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर (स्कॉलर रजिस्टर / जनरल रजिस्टर) विद्यालय का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण स्थायी विधिक और प्रशासनिक अभिलेख होता है। इसमें विद्यालय में प्रवेश लेने वाले प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी का पूरा नाम, जन्मतिथि, माता-पिता का नाम, श्रेणी, प्रवेश की तिथि, कक्षा-दर-कक्षा प्रगति तथा विद्यालय छोड़ने (स्थानांतरण प्रमाण पत्र जारी करने) का स्थायी ब्योरा दर्ज होता है। शिक्षा संहिताओं के अनुसार इस रजिस्टर को संस्था में स्थायी रूप से संरक्षित रखा जाता है। विकल्प (a) उपस्थिति रजिस्टर एक अस्थायी रिकॉर्ड है। विकल्प (b) लॉग बुक विद्यालय के महत्वपूर्ण आयोजनों और निरीक्षण टिप्पणियों के लिए होती है। विकल्प (d) छात्रों के गुणात्मक व्यवहार संबंधी अभिलेख हैं।

questions.question_english: In the context of school administration and organizational behavior, which of the following factors is categorized as a 'Hygiene Factor' under Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, serving to prevent dissatisfaction without intrinsically motivating teachers?
options_english: Institutional policies and school administration
Personal sense of autonomy and job responsibility
Opportunities for career advancement and professional growth
Formal recognition of pedagogical achievement
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Frederick Herzberg's Motivation-Hygiene Theory distinguishes between hygiene (extrinsic) factors and motivators (intrinsic). Hygiene factors include institutional policies, administrative practices, supervision quality, working conditions, salary, and interpersonal relations. Their presence eliminates job dissatisfaction and creates a healthy baseline, but does not actively drive high-level intrinsic motivation or superior engagement. In contrast, responsibility (b), career advancement (c), and recognition of achievement (d) are true 'Motivators' that foster job satisfaction and professional excellence.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग के द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत के अनुसार, कारकों को दो श्रेणियों में बांटा गया है: आरोग्य (हाइजीन या बाह्य) कारक और प्रेरक (मोटिवेटर्स या आंतरिक) कारक। संस्थागत नीतियां, प्रशासन, वेतन, कार्यदशाएं और पर्यवेक्षण की गुणवत्ता 'हाइजीन कारक' हैं। यदि ये संतोषजनक हों, तो कार्यस्थल पर असंतोष समाप्त हो जाता है, किंतु ये शिक्षकों में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए आंतरिक प्रेरणा नहीं भरते। इसके विपरीत, कार्य की जिम्मेदारी (b), पदोन्नति के अवसर (c) और उपलब्धियों की पहचान (d) वास्तविक 'प्रेरक' हैं जो आत्म-संतुष्टि और प्रेरणा उत्पन्न करते हैं।

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements most accurately delineates the fundamental conceptual difference between Human Resource Management (HRM) and Human Resource Development (HRD)?

HRD functions strictly as a subordinate component of HRM that deals exclusively with short-term employee orientation workshops

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). questions.question_english: The theory of 'Bounded Rationality' in administrative decision-making, which posits that administrators operate under cognitive constraints, incomplete information, and time pressures, thereby 'satisficing' rather than optimizing, was propounded by:
options_english: Peter F. Drucker
Max Weber
Herbert A. Simon
Chester I. Barnard
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Herbert A. Simon formulated the concept of 'Bounded Rationality' in administrative behavior, for which he was awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 1978. Simon challenged classical economic theories that assumed perfectly rational decision-makers with complete information and infinite computing ability. Instead, he argued that real-world administrators face cognitive limitations, incomplete information, and restricted time, compelling them to choose solutions that meet acceptable criteria—a process he termed 'satisficing'.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रशासनिक व्यवहार में 'सीमित तार्किकता' (Bounded Rationality) की अवधारणा का प्रतिपादन हर्बर्ट ए. साइमन ने किया था (जिसके लिए उन्हें 1978 में अर्थशास्त्र का नोबेल पुरस्कार मिला)। साइमन ने शास्त्रीय 'पूर्ण तार्किकता' के विचार को चुनौती देते हुए कहा कि वास्तविक जीवन में प्रशासकों के पास सीमित जानकारी, सीमित समय और संज्ञानात्मक सीमाएं होती हैं। इसलिए वे पूर्ण अनुकूलतम (ऑप्टिमाइज्ड) निर्णय लेने के बजाय ऐसा निर्णय चुनते हैं जो उस परिस्थिति के लिए 'पर्याप्त रूप से संतोषप्रद' (Satisficing) हो।
questions.topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Herbert Simon

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Herbert Simon introduced the concept of bounded rationality, asserting that administrative decision-makers face cognitive limitations, incomplete information, time constraints, and computational boundaries. Consequently, managers cannot achieve absolute optimization. Instead, they seek solutions that are acceptable or good enough, a decision-making strategy known as satisficing rather than global maximizing.

questions.question_english: In Prof. Udai Pareek’s OCTAPACE culture framework for HRD climate, the concept of 'Experimentation' primarily encourages:
options_english: Testing innovative problem-solving approaches without fear of failure penalties
Conducting hazardous laboratory experiments without mandated safety gear
Altering academic curriculum mid-session without board authorization
Reporting to duty at arbitrary hours to challenge attendance tracking
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). In Udai Pareek’s OCTAPACE framework, 'Experimentation' refers to cultivating an institutional climate that encourages educators and administrative personnel to pilot innovative teaching strategies, adopt novel problem-solving techniques, and take calculated creative risks. A healthy HRD culture treats setbacks and unexpected outcomes not as punishable offenses, but as valuable organizational learning experiences that catalyze ongoing pedagogical improvement.

questions.question_english: In educational administration, 'Academic Mentoring' fundamentally distinguishes itself from basic supervisory oversight because mentoring involves:
options_english: Short-term administrative procedures focused on formal evaluation and grading
Directive supervision where mentors instruct mentees to follow rigid scripts
A supportive relationship guiding holistic professional and psychosocial growth
Periodic external inspection conducted to verify baseline rule compliance
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Academic mentoring transcends routine administrative supervision by establishing a sustained, developmental partnership centered on holistic growth. While conventional supervision is primarily evaluative, regulatory, and focused on institutional compliance, mentoring is non-evaluative and collegial. It provides personalized guidance, emotional resilience, constructive feedback, and career mentoring, empowering educators to hone pedagogical competencies and achieve long-term professional maturity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। अकादमिक मेंटरिंग (मार्गदर्शन) सामान्य प्रशासनिक पर्यवेक्षण से गुणात्मक रूप से भिन्न है। पारंपरिक पर्यवेक्षण पदानुक्रमित, औपचारिक और मुख्य रूप से नियमों के अनुपालन तथा कार्य निष्पादन के मूल्यांकन तक सीमित होता है। इसके विपरीत, मेंटरिंग एक गैर-मूल्यांकनपरक, सहयोगात्मक और विकासात्मक संबंध है जो शिक्षक के व्यावसायिक कौशलों के संवर्धन के साथ-साथ उसके मनोसामाजिक विकास, भावनात्मक संबल और दीर्घकालिक आत्म-विश्वास को सुदृढ़ बनाने पर केंद्रित होता है।
